arcade.title: Arcade
arcade.description: Short skill games to sharpen your touch between matches. Every run counts toward your daily and weekly challenges.
arcade.quitHint: Press Esc to leave the run

targetRush.name: Target Rush
targetRush.tagline: 60 seconds, as many targets as you can.
targetRush.description: Targets pop up on the opponent's half. Send the puck through them, chain hits to raise your multiplier and finish with the highest score.
rules: Move your mallet with the mouse and strike the puck toward the targets.
Standard targets are worth 100 points, gold targets 300. A goal scores nothing: aim for the targets.
Consecutive hits raise the multiplier up to ×4. A shot that comes back empty resets it.
Targets shrink and start moving as the clock runs down.

goalieReflex.name: Goalie Reflex
goalieReflex.tagline: Hold the line as the shots speed up.
goalieReflex.description: Viper fires an endless stream of shots at your goal. Block them, clear them and keep your three lives as long as you can.
rules: Stay between the puck and your goal, then send it back up the table.
Each clearance counts as one save and makes the next shot faster.
Bank shots arrive after a few saves, double shots after ten.
Every goal conceded costs a life. The run ends when you have none left.

bankShot.name: Bank Shot
bankShot.tagline: Use the rails to find the way in.
bankShot.description: Puzzle levels where the direct line is blocked. Play the angles off the rails and bumpers to score with as few shots as possible.
rules: Hit the puck once per shot; it then rolls on its own.
Score in the opponent's goal before you run out of shots.
First shot earns 3 stars, second shot 2, any later shot 1.
Clear a level to unlock the next one.
